temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt with Keith over the past few days. When Keith asks whether he has upset her, Elizabeth says no, not at all, and explains she is dealing with personal stuff, apologizing if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith suspects Elizabeth may be upset with him, possibly because of a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Elizabeth's explanation rules out anger at Keith and attributes her curtness to personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal stress and may be struggling.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and consider offering support to help her through whatever she is dealing with.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith offers support and suggests a coffee break. Elizabeth accepts, says it sounds good, and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed/confirmed: Elizabeth is receptive to his support and appreciates his offer.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is open to receiving support from him, and a coffee break is welcome.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To spend the coffee break listening to her and offering support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe. Keith suggests professional help, and Elizabeth says she has thought about it but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress, is open to his support, and appreciated the coffee break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Her stress is more severe than he knew; professional help might benefit her, but she is hesitant and unsure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth may need professional help but is hesitant; Keith should support her without pressuring or offending her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently encourage professional help while respecting her hesitation and continuing to offer support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After Keith suggested professional help, Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn. Keith apologizes for possibly overstepping. Elizabeth says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is just a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes his suggestion may have embarrassed Elizabeth or overstepped, and he feels regretful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Changed: Elizabeth says he did not overstep and appreciates his concern, but she is still processing it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He did not offend her, but the topic is heavy and she needs time to think; she appreciates his support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful and guilty before her response; relieved but still concerned afterward.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her, avoid pushing professional help, and remain available without pressure.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative. She thanks Keith, says his support means a lot, and says she feels better knowing she has his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He did not overstep; Elizabeth appreciates his concern but is processing a lot and may need time.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Confirmed/strengthened: Elizabeth values his support, feels better, and is more comfortable with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels more comfortable around him; their supportive relationship is positive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and remain available for chats or breaks.
